title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for 2027 (Undergraduate Students) - Embassy Recommendation
official_source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
program_type: Government scholarship - national study abroad programme (embassy recommendation)
duration: 5 years including one year of Japanese language training at ABK College or Osaka University (7 years for medicine, dentistry, veterinary science and 6-year pharmacy); up to a standard school year under university recommendation
description: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for 2027 (Undergraduate Students) funds international students who will study at Japanese national universities as undergraduates. MEXT publishes the terms in the FY2027 Application Guidelines and the application is made through a Japanese embassy or consulate general, or through a university recommendation. The award pays a monthly scholarship, exempts tuition at the accepting university and provides round-trip airfare. Under embassy recommendation the scholarship runs for five years including one year of Japanese language training.
